messages.setup.title: First setup
messages.setup.token_help: Enter the one-time setup token printed in the container log. You can read it with:
messages.setup.admin_fixed: The administrator account is always called “admin”: it cannot be renamed or deleted.
messages.setup.password_rules: At least 12 characters, with at least three of: lower-case, upper-case, digits, symbols (or 20+ characters). It must not contain the user name.
messages.setup.final_warning: After this step the wizard is locked permanently. Keep the master key in a password manager: without it the encrypted vault cannot be recovered.
messages.setup.done: Setup completed. You can now sign in.
messages.db.filename_hint: The file is created in the /state volume (WAL mode).
messages.db.mariadb_privileges: Required privileges on the database: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, ALTER, INDEX, DROP (DROP only to purge a failed migration target). CREATE on the server only if the database must be created automatically.
messages.db.structure_present: The database already contains the structure: it will be reused without touching the data.
messages.db.structure_will_be_created: The structure does not exist yet and will be created automatically.
messages.db.in_use_by: Warning: the database is in use by another instance ({host}).
messages.db.needs_migration: The schema is older (version {from}): it will be migrated to version {to} only after your confirmation.
messages.db.confirm_migration: I made a backup and I confirm the migration of the database schema.
messages.db.change_help: Enter the parameters of the new database and test the connection. The current database is never modified or deleted.
messages.db.switch_point_pause: Running jobs are paused on a checkpoint in the current database; no job starts during the switch.
messages.db.switch_point_old_kept: The current database is not modified or deleted: you can come back to it later.
messages.db.switch_point_reconcile: The state of the new database is compared with the files on disk; differences go to review and are never corrected automatically.
messages.db.switch_point_rollback: If anything fails you stay on the current database without losing data.
messages.db.migration_text: The database uses schema version {from}; this application needs version {to}. Make a backup before continuing.
messages.db.migration_backup: Make a backup of the database before migrating the schema. The migration cannot be undone by the application.
messages.db.current_needs_migration: The configured database uses schema version {from}; the application needs {to}.
messages.home.title: Home
messages.home.intro: Reorganize your photos and videos safely: files are moved (never copied or deleted), nothing is overwritten, and every write has a preview and needs your confirmation.
messages.home.step_scan: Index your source folders and compute SHA-256 hashes.
messages.home.step_duplicates: Find exact duplicates and move them to the duplicates folder.
messages.home.step_metadata: Complete missing metadata only from reliable sources.
messages.home.step_report: Check the report, verify, undo if needed.
messages.job.scan_result: {indexed} indexed · {hashed} hashed · {reused} hashes reused · {unhashed} without a hash
messages.job.scan_result_legacy: {indexed} indexed · {hashed} hashed; unchanged files reuse hashes (not counted in older scans).
messages.job.needs_confirmation: This job writes or moves files: it resumes only when you click Resume.
messages.jobs.title: Jobs
messages.jobs.intro: Background jobs of the current database, with progress and checkpoints.
messages.scan.title: Analyze
messages.scan.intro: Read-only, resumable analysis: scan, hash, capture dates, exact duplicates and metadata proposals. Unchanged hashes and capture dates are reused.
messages.scan.no_sources: No source folder is assigned to you. Ask an administrator.
messages.dup.title: Duplicates
messages.dup.intro: Exact duplicates within all your folders. Duplicates are moved to the duplicates folder, never deleted.
messages.dup.rule: Duplicate = same size, same SHA-256 and byte-by-byte comparison. A known internal capture date is shared across identical copies, then the tidiest path decides. Without a known capture date: oldest file-system date, then tidiest path.
messages.dup.keeper_rule.capture_date_tidy_path: Rule: shared capture date, then tidiest path
messages.dup.keeper_rule.mtime_tidy_path: Rule: equal file-system dates, then tidiest path
messages.meta.title: Metadata
messages.meta.intro: Analyses EXIF, IPTC, XMP and QuickTime tags of photos and videos and prepares the completion of missing fields.
messages.meta.rule_copy: A missing field is completed only by copying it from a reliable source of the same file or its linked files (equivalent tags, .xmp, Google Takeout .json).
messages.meta.rule_never_invent: Values deduced from the file name or modification date are only proposals for review.
messages.meta.rule_never_overwrite: An existing value is never overwritten.
messages.meta.rule_video_utc: QuickTime dates are usually UTC: ambiguity is reported, never converted blindly.
messages.meta.rule_backup: Original values are stored in the database before any change; pixels and encoding are never touched.
messages.org.title: Organize
messages.org.intro: Moves files into Year/Month/Day folders inside the destination of the source, using the normalised date.
messages.org.rule_no_date: Files without a reliable date go to the “no date” folder.
messages.org.rule_no_rename: Files are not renamed; a different file with the same name gets a numeric suffix, nothing is overwritten.
messages.org.rule_companions: Linked files (.xmp, .aae, Live Photo) move with their original.
messages.org.rule_volumes: On different volumes the file is copied, verified by hash, and only then the original is removed.
messages.plan.title: Preview
messages.plan.intro: Nothing has been changed yet. Check the list and confirm to execute it.

plan.summary.one: {count} item: {planned} to do, {done} done, {blocked} blocked or skipped
plan.summary.other: {count} items: {planned} to do, {done} done, {blocked} blocked or skipped

messages.plan.confirm_safety: Every item is checked again before execution; anything that changed in the meantime is skipped and sent to review. The manifest is written before each change and allows undo.
messages.plan.note.source_missing: the file is no longer there
messages.plan.note.file_changed: the file changed after the preview
messages.plan.note.value_present: a value is now present (never overwritten)
messages.plan.note.exiftool_write_failed: ExifTool could not write this file
messages.review.title: Review
messages.review.intro: Files that need a decision. Decisions are saved immediately: you can stop and resume at any time.
messages.review.counts: {pending} pending · {saved} saved · {skipped} skipped · {kept} left as they are
messages.review.write_help: Saved values are written only into fields that are missing in the file, after a preview and your confirmation.
messages.review.cannot_play: The browser cannot play this video.
messages.review.origin.mtime_utc: deduced from the file-system modification date
messages.review.utc_ambiguous: This date comes from a UTC tag and the time zone is unknown: check the day.
messages.review.date_choice_hint: Saved in the database only, for organizing; the file is not changed. Choosing a date clears unsaved Date taken and Creation date edits. To write a date, enter it in a missing field and preview writing.
messages.review.scope.folder: all pending files of this folder
messages.field.title: Title
messages.report.title: Report & undo
messages.report.intro: Summary of the current database, manifest, undo and final verification.
messages.report.undo_db_note: Undo reads the manifest of the current database. Operations done with another database can be undone only by switching back to it (or after migrating its data).
messages.report.verify_help: Checks that files and hashes match the index and the manifest.
messages.logs.title: Logs
messages.logs.intro: Execution log of the current database. Entries are always in English.
messages.audit.english_note: The administrative audit log is stored in the encrypted vault. Entries are always in English.
messages.me.title: My account
messages.me.must_change: You must change your password before continuing.
messages.admin.http_warning: Warning: this application uses plain HTTP. Passwords and session cookies travel unencrypted on the network: use it only on trusted networks, restrict access with BIND_ADDRESS and ALLOWED_NETWORKS, or put your own HTTPS reverse proxy in front of it.
messages.admin.reset_password_confirm: Generate a new temporary password for {username}? Their sessions end immediately.
messages.admin.delete_user_confirm: Delete {username}? Their records in the database are kept and can be reassigned.
messages.admin.username_rules: 3–40 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
messages.admin.generated_password_once: This password is shown only once. The user must change it at the first sign-in.
messages.admin.sources_rules: Sources of different users must not overlap or be nested. Source and destination should be on the same volume (atomic moves).
messages.admin.orphans_help: Records of accounts that no longer exist (for example after the vault was recreated). Reassign them to a recreated user.
messages.admin.groups_help: Groups organize base users; deactivating a group blocks the sign-in of its members.
messages.admin.delete_group_confirm: Delete the group {name}? Users are not deleted.
messages.settings.exclude_hint: Shell patterns, e.g. .* or @eaDir. Symbolic links are never followed.
messages.settings.preview_crf: Quality of video previews (CRF, lower is better)
messages.settings.default_lang_hint: Used before sign-in and for users who have not chosen a language. Only the admin can change it.
messages.security.network_text: Only HTTP is served (internal port 80, published on 7777). Limit exposure with BIND_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1 and ALLOWED_NETWORKS in the .env file, or add an external HTTPS proxy: the application needs no change.
messages.security.key_text: The master key encrypts the vault with accounts, configuration and credentials. It is never stored in /state.
messages.security.key_loss: If the key is lost the vault cannot be recovered: there is no back door. Keep it in a password manager.
messages.security.rotate_intro: A new key is generated and the vault is re-encrypted with it. The previous file is kept as vault.enc.pre-rotation (encrypted with the old key) for rollback.
messages.security.step_save: Save the key in your password manager.
messages.security.step_paste: Paste it below to confirm you saved it.
messages.security.step_env: After the rotation, replace APP_MASTER_KEY in the .env file (or the secret file).
messages.security.rotated: Vault re-encrypted. Update the .env file now: the old key no longer opens it.
messages.transfer.intro: Move the operational data between databases, also across versions and technologies (SQLite ↔ MariaDB). The source is only read.
messages.transfer.export_help: Creates an encrypted, verifiable archive in /state/exports that you can also download. During the export the application is in maintenance mode.
messages.transfer.import_help: Loads an archive into an empty destination database. The archive is fully verified before anything is written.
messages.transfer.migrate_help: Copies the current database directly into an empty destination database, with the same checks, without an intermediate file.
messages.transfer.passphrase_hint: At least 12 characters. It is needed to import the archive: it is not stored anywhere.
messages.transfer.destination_empty: The destination must be empty; the structure is created automatically. Existing data is never merged or overwritten.
messages.transfer.upload_hint: For very large archives copy the file into /state/imports instead.
messages.transfer.confirm_export: Export the current database to an encrypted archive.
messages.transfer.confirm_import: Import the archive into the destination database.
messages.transfer.confirm_migrate: Copy the current database into the destination database.
messages.transfer.source_untouched: The source is only read; the destination stays marked “migration in progress” until the copy is verified.
messages.transfer.resume_text: The migration resumes from the last checkpoint of each table.
messages.transfer.purge_text: The tables created in the destination by this failed transfer will be dropped. The source is not touched.
messages.transfer.purge_check: I want to empty the destination.
messages.transfer.warn.schema_upgrade: The data comes from an older schema: it will be upgraded to the current version after the copy.
messages.transfer.warn.schema_too_new: The data comes from a newer version of the application.
messages.transfer.warn.mariadb_binary_collation: On MariaDB paths use a binary (case-sensitive) collation, so paths that differ only in case never collide.
messages.transfer.warn.mariadb_packet_size: Very long rows need a sufficient max_allowed_packet on the MariaDB server (16 MB or more).
